question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"poised."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Poised"** means balanced, composed, and ready for action. (किसी हरकत के लिए तैयार (परंतु वस्‍तुतः करना शेष))

 
 
• **Example**: *My pencil was **poised**__ over the page, ready to take down her words.*
 
 
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it fits the context of being ready to perform a certain task.
 
• Grammatically, it is the correct form of the adjective to be used in this sentence.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.
 
• **Correct passage**:

......I looked up and saw a great orange-gold leopard, sleek and spotted, __**poised**__ on a rock......​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Swinging** refers to a back-and-forth movement, usually involving something hanging or suspended. (आगे-पीछे होने वाली गतिविधि, जिसमें आमतौर पर कोई चीज़ लटकती या निलंबित होती है)
 
• **Dancing** refers to moving rhythmically to music, usually in a social or performance setting. (आमतौर पर किसी सामाजिक या प्रदर्शन सेटिंग में संगीत की ओर लयबद्ध तरीके से आगे बढ़ना)
 
• **Playing** refers to engaging in an activity for enjoyment or as a competition. (आनंद के लिए या प्रतियोगिता के रूप में किसी गतिविधि में शामिल होना)
